title: Water below deck
body:
Read the passage based on the account and answer the question that follows.

After the great wave, the starboard side of Wavewalker was bashed open and water poured in with each wave. Larry and Herb were pumping like madmen. In the children's cabin, Sue said her head hurt a bit, pointing to a big bump above her eyes, but the narrator had no time to worry about bumped heads. He stretched canvas over the gaping holes. When the hand pumps blocked with debris and the electric pump short-circuited, he found another electric pump under the chartroom floor. The night dragged on with an endless, bitterly cold routine of pumping, steering and working the radio. They were getting no replies to their Mayday calls, which, the narrator says, was not surprising in this remote corner of the world. By then Sue's head had swollen alarmingly, she had two enormous black eyes and a deep cut on her arm. Asked why she had not made more of her injuries, she replied that she did not want to worry them when they were trying to save everyone.
